patch_description:
This crossover keeps the current program’s equilateral convex hull and barycentric feasibility guarantee, while adopting the prior program’s much more efficient batched population evaluation, differential proposals, elite preservation, restart diversity, and sparse final refinement.

All candidate layouts remain inside the fixed triangular hull through normalized nonnegative barycentric weights. The objective evaluates all 286 triangles in vectorized batches, allowing substantially broader deterministic exploration than a single-chain annealer. A final bottleneck-aware sparse polishing phase focuses perturbations on points participating in currently limiting triangles.
